newsitem.title: USA: Sen. Thurmond widens lead in South Carolina polls.
newsitem.headline: Sen. Thurmond widens lead in South Carolina polls.

text.p: Republican Strom Thurmond, 93, widened his projected lead over a Democratic opponent 50 years his junior, The State newspaper of Columbia reported Thursday.
Thurmond faces real estate developer and textiles heir Elliott Close, 43, who has never held elective office.
Voters prefer Thurmond over Close 54 percent to 38 percent, The State reported, citing a survey taken over the weekend by The Mason-Dixon Political/Media Research organisation.
The poll of 828 registered voters showed 8 percent were undecided. It had a margin of error of 3.5 percentage points.
Close's latest television advertisement, titled "Nursing Home," has video footage of Thurmond hobbling along with the help of aides, according to the newspaper.
"It's clear that the misleading and disrespectful ads ... are backfiring," a Thurmond campaign aide told The State.
Thurmond turns 94 in December. If re-elected he would be 100 when his term ends.
